ELI5: Why are blue eyes a recessive trait?

Broken genes are normally recessive. If you have red hair you don't have a gene which gets rid of the red pigments because you got two broken ones. If you got a broken and a working one the working one is dominant so no red hair for you. Same for blue eyes. So blue eyes means you have two broken ones which can't produce some pigments.
